```sql
select
  case
    when o.channel = 'online_pickup' then 'online pickup'
    when o.channel = 'in_store' then 'walk-in'
  end as key,
  count(*) as value
from orders o
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
where not o.is_test
  and s.country_code in ('GB')
  and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
  and o.channel in ('online_pickup', 'in_store')
group by key
order by value desc, key asc
```
